mqttClients.intro: MQTT credentials for the external systems that need this organization's data: a SCADA, Node-RED, a MES. They are read-only: they see this organization's tag values and alarms, and cannot write anything to the broker.
mqttClients.what_for_ph: e.g. Node-RED line 1, control room SCADA
mqttClients.once: Copy the password now: it will not be shown again. If you lose it, revoke these credentials and create new ones.
mqttClients.copy_failed: Could not copy: select the text and copy it by hand
mqttClients.empty_desc: No external system has MQTT access to this organization's data yet.
mqttClients.revoke_desc: The system using them will no longer be able to connect to the broker.
mqttClients.show_desc: Viewing is logged. Do not paste it into unprotected chat or email.
mqttClients.rotate_desc: Applies on the broker immediately: update the external system too.

mqttMaintenance.registry_desc: Every login created for an external system, with broker status. Creation and rotation stay in the single organization infrastructure dialog.
mqttMaintenance.empty_desc: No organization has created MQTT access for external apps yet.
mqttMaintenance.manage_hint: To rotate a password or enable/disable a login, open its organization infrastructure dialog.
mqttMaintenance.broker_desc: Every identity the broker knows (drivers, viewers, external systems). Finds logins created outside the registry.
mqttMaintenance.orphans_title: {count} broker identities without a registry row
mqttMaintenance.orphans_desc: Created outside the platform or leftovers of deleted orgs. Check against the registry before touching them.
